==Usage==
Place the following code on the page and replace the "issue number", "story name" and "formatted name" with the appropriate information.
 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>ShadisCite|''ISSUE NUMBER''|''STORY NAME''|''FORMATTED NAME'' (optional)}}
